rulings.Calendar Matter: Motion To Set Aside Dismissal With Prejudice Pursuant To Ccp 473(B) And Leave To File First Amended Complaint
rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for September 14, 2026. Line 1.1. Plaintiff's Motion to Set Aside Dismissal with Prejudice 473(b) and Leave to File First Amended Complaint is DENIED. Moving party failed to carry their burden under CCP 473(b). Notice of Entry of Demurrer order was filed by Plaintiff on April 7, 2026. Amended Complaint was due no later than April 17, 2026. CRC 3.1320(g). On May 29, 2026 the Court issued an Order to Show Cause why the action should not be dismissed for failure to file an amended complaint. By that time the amended complaint was over a month overdue. The Court gave Plaintiff an opportunity to file a response to the OSC by July 30, 2026, which Plaintiff did not do. The Court gave Plaintiff an opportunity to appear for hearing on August 4, 2026, and address the OSC orally, which Plaintiff did not do. Plaintiff's motion does not address any of the relevant deadlines, but references August 3, 2026, without explaining the significance of this date. Since dismissal remains on file, the request to file an amended complaint in a dismissed action is denied. =(501/CFH) Parties may appear in-person, telephonically or via Zoom (Video - Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849; or Phone Dial in: (669) 254-5252; Webinar ID: 160 560 5023; Password: 172849).
